text:
- **CI speed and runners:** Vet and golden checks now run on Linux only. Each pull request starts at most two macOS jobs. Docs-only pull requests skip the Go test matrix and pass merge-ready. The median wall time did not reach the goal, because macOS runner capacity limits speed. A lock-free records read no longer passes while git rewrites the store. Work started to make the agent guidance jobs finish within the other checks.
- **Agent guidance map:** The AGENTS.md file is now a short map under its size limit. Narration moved next to the code it describes. A new evaluation runner tests the file, and CI runs it on every pull request. The owner reviewed and merged this work.
- **Sprint close rules:** A sprint close now checks only the coverage patterns that sprint added or changed. Another session's older pending pattern no longer blocks it. The pm check waiting line and help text state this rule. The owner reviewed and merged this change.
